reasons.plausibility: Separating and modeling lattice and electronic contributions independently is scientifically sound for high-entropy alloys, though the exact degree of improved accuracy (30%) may be somewhat optimistic.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment with two sets of specimens and direct thermal conductivity measurements across a broad temperature range provides a clear, decisive means to confirm or refute the predicted improvement.
reasons.usefulness: It directly targets a known gap in modeling thermal transport in refractory high-entropy alloys, offering a concrete route to improve predictive accuracy and guide materials optimization.
